agent_explanation: Shrunk 2-body scenario starts with zero total momentum and close separation ~1.49. After a single dt=0.006 step, the impulses are not equal and opposite: light body gains ~0.057 upward velocity while heavy body gains only ~0.0029 downward. Weighted momentum becomes ~0.0057, exceeding allowed ~0.0011. Equal-mass counterfactual with identical geometry and dt conserves momentum, indicating the force/impulse update is not symmetric under unequal masses (Newton's 3rd law violated numerically, e.g., forces computed with mass-dependent softening or per-body substep weighting).
